Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX.4.2 Must be first field in message

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Length of message following Body Length field up to and including the delimiter preceding the Check Sum field. Must be second field in message.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Must be third field in message

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: ID of sender: Assigned by CFE for messages sent to CFE (Target Comp IDfor messages from CFE)

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: Sub ID of sender: Assigned by CFE for messages sent to CFE. (Target Sub IDfor messages from CFE)

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: ID of destination: CFE=messages sent to CFE (Sender Comp IDfor messages from CFE)

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Sub ID of destination: TEST=messages sent to CFE test system PROD=messages sent to CFE production system (Sender Sub IDfor messages from CFE)

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequential sequence number for session

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: N=(Default) Y=Indicates a message resend and should be used during FIX Replay. All inbound orders with a value of ‘Y’ will be rejected by Cboe.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: GMT date-time that message was sent

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: For messages with Poss Dup Flag=‘Y’, indicates time that message was first sent

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: Used to specify clearing information on messages to CFE. Must be an allowed Executing Firm ID (EFID). Sent to OCC in Exec Broker field.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfSubID
Field.Description: End-client sub identifier. 4 Characters alphanumeric, otherwise not validated. Recorded and returned in Deliver To Sub ID. Available via Drop feeds

Field.Name: DeliverToCompId
Field.Description: Identifies end-client on messages from CFE. Used to specify clearing information

Field.Name: DeliverToSubID
Field.Description: Returns On Behalf Of Sub IDoptionally sent by client

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Three byte, simple checksum. Always unencrypted, always last field in message.

Field.Name: TradeDate
Field.Description: Business date of the Execution Report. Note that on CFE,Trade Dateis not always the same as the calendar date. For example, the VX/VT products open for trading on the calendar day prior to the associated business date or Trade Date. Executions that occur after the open and before midnight will have a Trade Datethat is not the same as the calendar date of the execution.

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: 0=New 1=Cancel 2=Correct 3=Status 2(Correct) is used for post-Settlement Execution Reports that update Trade At Settlement (TAS) trades with settlement offset prices and symbol changes as appropriate. 3(Status) is used for Carried Order Restatements if associated port attribute is set.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Day-unique ID of execution message. Will be zero when Exec Trans Type=3.

Field.Name: SecondaryExecID
Field.Description: Field indicates whether a fill or partial fill (Exec Type(150) =1or2) is a Spread instrument fill or a Simple instrument fill that comprises a Spread execution. If Secondary Exec ID(527) is not present, the fill is a Simple instrument fill only. If Secondary Exec IDis present and is the same as the Exec ID(17) the fill represents a Spread execution for which associated Simple instrument fills will follow. Simple instrument fills associated with a Spread execution will contain a Secondary Exec IDmatching the Exec IDof the associated Spread execution.

Field.Name: ExecRefID
Field.Description: Only present when Exec Trans Type=1(Cancel) or2(Correct). Refers to the Exec IDof the message being cancelled or corrected.

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Reason for this execution report: 0=New (acknowledgement of new order) 1=Partial Fill 2=Fill 4=Canceled 5=Replaced 8=Rejected D=Restated M=Mass Cancel Complete For Standard FIX Drop, only Exec Type=1(Partial Fill),2(Fill), and D (Restated) Execution Reports will be sent. For Order by Order FIX Drop, all Exec Typeswill be sent. See FIX Drop Port information in FIX Drop Port Attributeson page 74. When responding to a Mass Cancel request,Exec Type=M. This indicates that the only tags present in this message are the following: Standard Message Header(35) Sending Time(52) Exec Trans Type(20) Exec Type(150) Mass Cancel ID(7695) Cancelled Order Count(7696)

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Cl Ord IDof the order being accepted, executed or rejected. -or- Cl Ord IDof the cancel or replace request. -or- Cl Ord IDof the order subject to unsolicited cancel (Orig Cl Ord IDwill not be present).

Field.Name: OrderId
Field.Description: Order Id(supplied by CFE). Sent to the OCC in the Exchange Data field.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: State of order: 0=New 1=Partially Filled 2=Filled 4=Canceled 5=Replaced 6=Pending Cancel 8=Rejected A=Pending Ack B=Calculated E=Pending Replace For FIX Drop, only ‘1’ or ‘2’ will be sent and will always equal Exec Type(150). For Order by Order FIX Drop, all execution information will be sent. Order Status (39) will always =Bfor TAS post-settlement restatements.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Copied from order (available in FIX DROP)

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Copied from order unless overridden by the system. For example, Market orders are implicitly IOC. Post-settlement restatement messages for TAS executions for which the associated order was submitted with Time In Force=4(FOK) will include Time In Force=3(IOC).

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Copied from order

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Copied from order

Field.Name: CMTANumber
Field.Description: Copied from order

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Copied from order

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Copied from order For FIX DROP and Order by Order DROP only, Execution Reports for Futures will always contain "Expiration Symbology" in fields Symbol(55), Maturity Month(200), and Maturity Day(205).Symbolwill always contain the Product identifier associated with the traded instrument (e.g., ‘VX’). Maturity Monthand Maturity Dayspecify the expiration of the traded instrument. Note if Multileg Reporting Type(442) is set to 3 (i.e., Spread execution), Expiration Symbology does not uniquely identify the traded option instrument, and in this case both Symbol(55) and Security ID(48) contain the 6 character mapped Symbol ID of the traded spread instrument. (Options only),Security Desc(107) and Symbol(55) are always populated for simple instruments.Symbol(55) will contain the 6-character mapped Symbol ID. Complex/spread instruments will only include Symbol(55).

Field.Name: MaturityMonth
Field.Description: Copied from order(Futures only). For FIX DROP and Order by Order DROP Execution Reports,Maturity Month (200) specifies the month component of the expiration date of the traded instrument. For Spread executions (i.e.,Multileg Reporting Type(442) = 3),Maturity Month (200) is not included since Symbol(55) contains mapped Symbol ID and not Expiration symbology.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Copied from order(Futures only). For FIX DROP and Order by Order DROP Execution Reports,Maturity Day (205) specifies the day component of the expiration date of the traded instrument. For Spread executions (i.e.,Multileg Reporting Type(442) = 3),Maturity Day (200) is not included since Symbol(55) contains mapped Symbol ID and not Expiration symbology.

Field.Name: SecurityDesc
Field.Description: (Options only) Long format description of Options instrument (e.g. "UX1A/K4 C2000").

Field.Name: SecurityID(Futures only)
Field.Description: Present only for FIX DROP and Order by Order DROP Execution Reports. Field will always contain the associated symbol using the 6-character mapped symbol id.

Field.Name: SenderLocationID
Field.Description: Copied from order

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: Copied from order

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Copied from order

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Copied from order Field not present on TAS post-settlement restatements.

Field.Name: DayOrderQty
Field.Description: For GTC and GTD orders only. Contracts remaining to be filled for the order at the beginning of the current business day (i.e.,Order Qty-Cum Qtyat the end of the previous business day).

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: Cumulative quantity of contracts executed for the order over life of the order, which may be multiple business days in the case of GTC and GTD orders. Populated for leg fills related to complex executions.

Field.Name: DayCumQty
Field.Description: For GTC and GTD orders only. Cumulative quantity of contracts executed for the order during the current business day.

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Quantity of contracts or spread instruments still open for further execution. Will be zero if order is dead, otherwise will be (Order Qty-Cum Qty).

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Copied from order

Field.Name: AvgPx
Field.Description: Average price of executions for this order weighted by trade size. Zero if Cum Qtyis zero or if a leg fill related to a complex execution.

Field.Name: DayAvgPx
Field.Description: For GTC and GTD orders only. Average price per contract of executions on current business date (Trade Date). Zero if Day Cum Qtyis zero.

Field.Name: StopPx
Field.Description: Copied from order

Field.Name: SecondaryOrderID
Field.Description: Present on a MTP triggered cancel. Must request opt-in at firm or port level for "Report MTP Fields" to receive this field.

Field.Name: TradeLiquidityIndicator
Field.Description: Present for acknowledgements and fills (150 =0, 150 =1or 150 =2): 11sstt CChhaarraacctteerr A=Trade Added Liquidity R=Trade Removed Liquidity C=Market opening/re-opening trade 22nndd CChhaarraacctteerr ((mmuusstt oopptt--iinn ttoo rreecceeiivvee)) U=Qualifying Market Turner order.Only sent when first character value=A. SSttaattee CChhaannggee TTrraacckkiinngg Order acks (150=0), modify acks (150=5) and restatements (150=D with 378=4 or 378=1) will carry 9730 messages defined as follows: A=Zero or more immediate partial remove fills followed by posting. AU=Zero or more immediate partial remove fills followed by posting as market turner. R=Zero or more immediate partial remove fills followed by a cancel (or full fill).

Field.Name: FeeCode
Field.Description: Specific fee code associated with execution. See the Fee Schedule for the respective market for possible values.

Field.Name: ModifySequence
Field.Description: FIX Drop only. Base 36. Number of times order has been replaced.

Field.Name: OrigCompID
Field.Description: FIX Drop only.Target Comp IDof original FIX exec report FIX Drop port must be configured to send this optional field.

Field.Name: OrigSubID
Field.Description: FIX Drop only.Target Sub IDof original FIX exec report FIX Drop port must be configured to send this optional field.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: GMT date-time that transaction occurred

Field.Name: CTICode
Field.Description: CTICode Copied from order

Field.Name: OrderCapacity
Field.Description: Order Capacity Copied from order if provided

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Open Close Copied from order

Field.Name: CustOrderHandlingInst
Field.Description: Cust Order Handling Inst Copied from order

Field.Name: TrdType
Field.Description: If present, the Execution represents a Block or an ECRP trade. 1=Block Trade 2=ECRP Trade Block and ECRP trades will only appear on Standard FIX DROP connections and not on Order-By-Order DROP connections or FIX sessions.

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: Only present on trades. Always1

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: Only present on trades. Always CFE

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of contracts traded on this fill (zero for nonfills). Must request opt-in at firm or port level for "Report MTP Fields" to receive this field on a MTP triggered cancel/restatement where both sides were cancelled.Last Sharesis set to the number of contracts that would have been matched in the event of cancel on account of MTP.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this fill (zero for non-fills). Must request opt-in at firm or port level for "Report MTP Fields" to receive this field on a MTP triggered cancel/restatement where both sides were cancelled.Last Pxis set to the price at which Last Shareswould have matched in the event of cancel on account of MTP.

Field.Name: MultilegReportingType
Field.Description: 1=Simple instrument execution 2=Simple instrument execution that is part of a Spread instrument execution. 3=Spread instrument execution.

Field.Name: TrdType
Field.Description: If present, the Execution represents a Block or an ECRP trade. 1=Block Trade 2=ECRP Trade Block and ECRP trades will only appear on Standard FIX DROP connections and not on Order-By-Order DROP connections or FIX sessions.

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: Only present on trades. Always1

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: Only present on trades. Always CFE

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of contracts traded on this fill (zero for nonfills). Must request opt-in at firm or port level for "Report MTP Fields" to receive this field on a MTP triggered cancel/restatement where both sides were cancelled.Last Sharesis set to the number of contracts that would have been matched in the event of cancel on account of MTP.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this fill (zero for non-fills). Must request opt-in at firm or port level for "Report MTP Fields" to receive this field on a MTP triggered cancel/restatement where both sides were cancelled.Last Pxis set to the price at which Last Shareswould have matched in the event of cancel on account of MTP.

Field.Name: MultilegReportingType
Field.Description: 1=Simple instrument execution 2=Simple instrument execution that is part of a Spread instrument execution. 3=Spread instrument execution.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Cl Ord IDof the order being cancelled or replaced (for a solicited Cancelor Cancel/Replace, otherwise not present).

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: If present, indicates reason for reject or cancel. Format is one letter reason code followed by colon and space followed by free form text (e.g., "N: No Liquidity at price"). See Reason Codeson page 78for a list of valid reason codes.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Cl Ord IDof the order being cancelled or replaced (for a solicited Cancelor Cancel/Replace, otherwise not present).

Field.Name: OrdRejReason
Field.Description: Optional when Exec Typeis Rejected (8): 0=Broker option 1=Unknown symbol 2=Exchange closed 3=Order exceeds limit 5=Unknown order 6=Duplicate order 8=Stale order

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: If present, indicates reason for reject or cancel. Format is one letter reason code followed by colon and space followed by free form text (e.g., "N: No Liquidity at price"). See Reason Codeson page 78for a list of valid reason codes.

Field.Name: ExecRestatementReason
Field.Description: Only present when 150=D 1=GTC and GTD Restatement 4=State Change 5=Reduction of Ord Qty 1is used for GTC and GTD Carried Order Restatements if associated port attribute is set. 4is used for post-Settlement Execution Reports that update Trade At Settlement (TAS) trades with settlement offset prices and symbol changes as appropriate. Restatements of Day orders on intraday system starts (for example, during holidays involving multiple trading segments for a day) will also use4.

Field.Name: ClearingPrice
Field.Description: Present in restatement execution reports in which the originally reported fill price (LastPx (31)) is transformed prior to clearing.

Field.Name: ClearingSymbol
Field.Description: Sent on FLEX restatements (150=D, 378=9) only.

Field.Name: MassCancelID
Field.Description: This field will be echoed back in the resulting order execution report when Mass Cancel Inst(7700) Acknowledgement Style =Sor B. Mass Cancel requests containing a Mass Cancel IDthat is currently outstanding will be rejected.

Field.Name: CancelledOrderCount
Field.Description: Number of orders cancelled from a Purge Request with the specified Mass- Cancel ID
